Each game uses a tracking tool to confirm the installs made through Aptoide. This campaign\'s rewards start once it confirms yours, usually a few minutes after you first open the game.\n\nKeep the game installed and play as usual. What you do in the game while you wait still counts once your install is confirmed.

Each game uses a tracking tool to confirm the installs made through Aptoide, and it decides which ones qualify. Installs its security checks flag, for example from emulators or automated tools, don\'t count for the campaign.\n\nOther Play & Earn games may still be available to you.
